36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
130664: Shinichi Sakurai is a tall, introverted college student with short brown hair. Shinichi enjoys peace and quiet and likes playing video games. He prefers to be left alone, but despite his objections, he often ends up hanging out with Hana.
130665: Hana Uzaki is a short, silver-haired college student with an energetic personality. Her antics often annoy her senpai, Shinichi.
157997: The wife of Fujio Uzaki, and the mother of Hana, Kiri, and Yanagi. While surprisingly old in age, she appears deceptively young and beautiful. Like her daughter, she is voluptuous.
159409: Itsuhito Sakaki is Shinichi's college classmate and friend. He likes to tease Shinichi about Hana, and he tries to cooperate with Ami to come up with plans to get Shinichi and Hana closer together.
159410: Ami Asai is Shinichi's coworker and Mr. Asai's daughter. She has medium length hair and wears glasses. Ami enjoys "people watching" and ogling attractive males, and she has a fond interest in watching the interactions between Shinichi and Hana.
189404: A nameless character. She instructs the main characters on rock climbing. Appears in Episode 11 of Season 1.
190106: Hana's younger brother, and a high-school junior.
191905: Yanagi Uzaki is Hana's younger sister and Junior High 2nd Year student. Yanagi has silver hair with extra-long bangs that shield her eyes. In her first appearance, she wore a darkish colored long sleeve shirt with a couple of vertical white stripes in the center.
293440: Shinichi's 8 month old baby sister that he didn't know he had.
326533: An owner of a ramen restaurant where Uzaki and Sakurai came to eat.
